questions.stem_text: Which of the following is true of interrupts?

options.A: They are generated when memory cycles are "stolen".
options.B: They are used in place of data channels.
options.C: They can indicate completion of an I/O operation.
options.D: They cannot be generated by arithmetic operations.

questions.answer_explanation: Interrupts serve as signals to the processor that an I/O operation has completed, allowing the system to efficiently manage tasks and resources without constant polling.

questions.stem_text: Which of the following is NOT a property of bitmap graphics?

options.A: Fast hardware exists to move blocks of pixels efficiently.
options.B: Realistic lighting and shading can be done.
options.C: All line segments can be displayed as straight.
options.D: Polygons can be filled with solid colors and textures.

questions.answer_explanation: The statement "All line segments can be displayed as straight" is incorrect for bitmap graphics because bitmap images are composed of pixels, which can only approximate curves and angles, often resulting in jagged edges or aliasing rather than smooth straight lines.

questions.stem_text: In Python 3, which of the following function convert a string to an int in python?
questions.answer_explanation: The function int(x [,base]) is designed to convert a string representation of a number into an integer, with an optional base parameter to specify the numeral system used for the conversion.

questions.stem_text:
Of the following problems concerning a given undirected graph G, which is currently known
to be solvable in polynomial time?

options.A: Finding a longest simple cycle in G
options.B: Finding a shortest cycle in G
options.C: Finding ALL spanning trees of G
options.D: Finding a largest clique in G

questions.answer_explanation: Finding a shortest cycle in an undirected graph can be solved in polynomial time using algorithms such as breadth-first search (BFS) to explore all paths and determine the shortest cycle efficiently.

questions.stem_text:
Of the following sorting algorithms, which has a running time that is LEAST dependent on
the initial ordering of the input?
questions.answer_explanation: Merge sort consistently divides and merges elements regardless of their initial order, resulting in a stable time complexity of O(n log n) that is unaffected by the arrangement of the input data.

questions.stem_text: Condition codes set by every instruction are not considered a barrier to aggressive pipelining of an integer unit.
questions.answer_explanation: Condition codes set by instructions can introduce dependencies and stalls in the pipeline, thereby acting as barriers to aggressive pipelining of an integer unit.

questions.stem_text: A 3-way, set-associative cache allows each main memory word to be stored in any of 3 different cache locations.
questions.answer_explanation: A 3-way, set-associative cache divides the cache into multiple sets, each containing three lines, allowing any given main memory word to be stored in any of the three lines within its designated set.

questions.stem_text: The language {ww | w in (0 + 1)*} is accepted by some Turing machines, but not by any pushdown automaton.
questions.answer_explanation: The language {ww | w in (0 + 1)*} requires the ability to compare two potentially unbounded strings for equality, which is a capability of Turing machines but exceeds the memory limitations of pushdown automata that can only use a single stack for recognition.

questions.stem_text: Identifier length is best specified using a context-free grammar in programming language design.
questions.answer_explanation: Identifier length in programming language design is better specified by context-sensitive grammar rather than context-free grammar because context-free grammars cannot enforce constraints that depend on the surrounding context, such as the specific lengths or formats of identifiers.

questions.stem_text: Python does not support integration with languages like C and Java, making it less versatile for system programming.
questions.answer_explanation: Python supports integration with languages like C and Java through various interfaces and libraries, such as ctypes, Cython, and Jython, which enhances its versatility in system programming.
